title: External authorizer: the contract and CrewCraft's decision rules
spec: docs/AUTHORIZER.md defines the HTTP contract (POST /v1/authorize with purpose and identity; allow with capabilities, a per-person increasing revision and an optional recheck_after_seconds, or deny with a revision; anything else is no answer). crewcraft-authz applies it: capabilities use, moderate, respond and dispatch, unknown names ignored, nothing counts without use; sign-in needs a fresh allow with use and never uses grace; a good answer is re-checked after 600 s or sooner if asked (at least 1 s); a check with no answer is retried after 60 s; a grant past its fresh period stands only within 24 h of its last confirmation, for staff, and never in the visitor area, however often retries move the next check; a deny takes effect at once, removes the grant and is lifted only by an allow with a higher revision; an allow with a revision below the highest seen, or at or below the denial, is stale and changes nothing; commit_decision refuses access when the record cannot be committed and read back unchanged.
